name: fundzwatch-mcp
description: Real-time business event intelligence for AI agents — AI-scored leads, funding events, refinancing windows (UCC), stacked borrowers, benefit-plan renewals, and watchlists from FundzWatch.ai
long_description: FundzWatch gives AI agents real-time access to verified business events: funding rounds, executive moves, acquisitions, and AI-scored leads matched to your ideal customer profile. NEW: five no-key-required answer sections — Funded & Hiring Now, UCC Refinancing Windows (Renewal Radar), Stacked Borrowers, Benefit Plans in Play (Form 5500), and a who-finances-whom Lender Directory — cross-dataset cohorts no single-source lookup can reproduce, re-scored daily. Manage watchlists and pull daily market briefs. Get a free API key (no credit card) at https://fundzwatch.ai/onboarding.

api_key.title: FundzWatch API Key
api_key.description: Your FundzWatch API key. Get a free key (no credit card) at https://fundzwatch.ai/onboarding

tools.name: get_scored_leads
tools.description: AI-scored sales leads based on your ICP with buyer intent, buying stage, and recommended outreach strategy

tools.name: get_events
tools.description: Real-time business events: funding rounds, acquisitions, executive hires, government contracts, product launches

types.description: Comma-separated: funding, acquisition, hiring, contract, product_launch. Default: all

tools.name: get_market_pulse
tools.description: Real-time market activity overview: funding totals, acquisitions, exec moves for the past 7 and 30 days

tools.name: get_market_brief
tools.description: Today's AI-generated strategic intelligence brief on market movements, patterns, and opportunities

tools.name: manage_watchlist
tools.description: Add, remove, or list companies on your watchlist; tracked companies generate alerts on new events

action.description: Action: 'list' to view, 'add' to track, 'remove' to untrack

tools.name: get_watchlist_events
tools.description: Recent events for companies on your watchlist: funding, acquisitions, exec hires, contracts

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Check your FundzWatch API usage: calls made, limits, current tier

tools.name: get_funded_and_hiring
tools.description: Companies funded in the last 12 months AND actively hiring (open roles, exec hires, hiring signals) — score-ranked daily. No API key required.

tools.name: get_refinancing_windows
tools.description: Companies whose active UCC-1 liens lapse within 12 months — each approaching lapse is a refinancing window with a date on it. For lenders, MCA/ISO, equipment finance. No API key required.

tools.name: get_stacked_borrowers
tools.description: Companies with active secured debt from 2+ distinct lenders (UCC) — second-position and consolidation targets. No API key required.

tools.name: get_benefit_plans_in_play
tools.description: Recently funded companies with a Form 5500 benefit plan on record — renewal timing, headcount-vs-plan gap, incumbent carrier. No API key required.

tools.name: get_lender_directory
tools.description: Directory of 8,600+ UCC secured parties ranked by filing volume, with lapsing-soon exposure per lender. No API key required.
